messages:
sara: quick heads-up — eu-west hosted GPU usage trending above our committed runway for next 30 days. graphs: https://redwood.internal/dash/runway?id=eu-west :alarm_clock:
ops-bot: [alert] reserved-utilization > 92% for cluster eu-west-1 (last 2h)
devin: pulling the numbers now, will paste a quick query
devin: ```sql
SELECT day, hosted_tokens, reserved_available_gpus, projected_gap
FROM capacity_forecast
WHERE region='eu-west'
AND model_family='gpt-medium'
ORDER BY day
LIMIT 14;
```
devin: paste: day1 92%, day2 95%, day3 99%... projected_gap +4 GPUs by day3 assuming current avg seq len
liam: any unexpected spikes (embeds/bulk inference) or is this organic customer growth?
sara: looks like a combination — one large embed job from customer X + normal growth from embeddings product
noah: can we route some low-priority traffic to us-west to buy runway? latency-sensitive routes should stay in eu-west
liam: yes can do policy for < 80ms SLA only, reroute rest to us-west. config snippet:
liam: ```yaml
routing:
  eu-west:
    priority: high
  us-west:
    priority: low
    max_latency_ms: 200
``` 
finance-ops: remind: if we burst into on-demand or add short-term rentals, cost center 412 will need approval. estimate of cost delta?
devin: rough estimate for 4 extra A100s in eu-west for 7 days = ~$18k (on-demand). If we reroute 30% traffic to us-west cost ~ $3k and avoids commitments.
sara: preferred: reroute what we can and open a short-term reserved rental for immediate slack of 1-2 GPUs if still short
ops-bot: ticket created: #INC-2145 'eu-west reserved runway pressure' assigned to eng-infra oncall
noah: I'll implement routing rule and deploy canary tonight, will post status
finance-ops: I'll pre-approve a $5k emergency budget for this window; if we need more will escalate
sara: action items:
 - noah: deploy cross-region fallback canary (by EOD)
 - liam: prepare routing policy PR and perf test (by tomorrow)
 - devin: re-run forecast with embedding job removed to check baseline sensitivity
 - finance-ops: hold $5k emergency fund and open billing ticket if we use on-demand
sara: thanks folks :thumbsup: keep updates in this thread
